  • Cyber: Israeli cyber chief: Iranian cyberattacks surged since the war began. Increased cyber risk to civilian infrastructure and media.
  • Air / Flights: Major regional airports closed: Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan. Flight scans show isolated military flights; civilian airspace disruption persists.
  • Markets / Economy: Oil prices up. Asian and global markets mixed; traders pricing in pause uncertainty and risk of renewed strikes.
  • Regional security: Pakistan conducting border operations in Afghanistan; Pakistan mediating US‑Iran dialogue.
  • Other: Iran denies report of missile toward Turkey. EU ministers rejected suspending association agreement with Israel (political, no hard measures).
  • 🟢 Good News: IDF tunnel demolition succeeded. Reported agreement to halt Hormuz attacks and scheduled Qatar talks reduce immediate sea-strike risk.
  • Threat assessment: escalating

Escalating.
